prompts.wall: Create a production sprite atlas for a 16-bit arcade shooter: BLUE/CHROME MATRIX CODE WALL and RED CODE SHIELD. Transparent background, crisp pixel clusters, metallic chrome highlights, electric royal-blue glow, no text labels, no checkerboard. Exactly FOUR equal square cells in a 2x2 grid on a 1024x1024 canvas, generous empty gutters. Top-left cell: exactly 12 evenly spaced horizontal rows of clean readable binary digits 0 and 1, each row a continuous horizontal line, blue steel faces and white/chrome bevel highlights, dark blue outlines, restrained glow. Fill an aligned 400x400 square centered in the cell, NO border or background panel. Numbers look like engraved luminous arcade pixels. Top-right cell: an EMPTY square blue/chrome energy wall rim with small corner emitter blocks, straight thin edges, transparent empty interior, inside opening occupying 85% of the square, matching the blue digits. Bottom-left cell: same twelve aligned horizontal binary rows but ruby RED digits with pale silver-white highlights and dark crimson outlines, NO border or background panel. Bottom-right cell: an EMPTY projected red energy shield rim, tall kite silhouette with squared broad top shoulders and tapered pointed bottom, mechanical chrome red perimeter, transparent empty interior; not a physical solid metal shield. Every individual cell centered and completely isolated. This is usable game art, front view orthographic, no perspective, no character, no backdrop, no extra objects.
prompts.impact: Create one production animation sprite sheet for a 16-bit arcade shooter code wall HIT FLASH. Transparent background. EXACTLY 8 equal square frames, 4 columns by 2 rows, 1024x512 canvas. Each frame is 256x256, same centered impact origin at exact center of its cell, chronological left to right then next row. Crisp authored pixel art with chrome-white hot center, electric blue short rays and tiny rectangular binary-chip sparks. Sequence: tiny white cross spark; bright compact star flare; peaked angular eight-direction chrome spark; small expanding diamond ripple; thin broken ripple with a few readable 0 and 1 chips; scattered little blue chips; faint glints; final minimal two glints. Peak radius at most 75px of each 256px cell. Entire animation stays inside each cell with broad transparent gutters. Strong attack feedback, NO large explosion cloud, NO ice crystals, NO giant sphere, NO wall or character baked in, NO labels or borders. Clear 16-bit pixel steps with controlled highlights, not blurred painting. Keep size and center coherent across frames.
prompts.shatter: Create one coherent 16-bit arcade CODE WALL DESTRUCTION animation spritesheet. Transparent background, EXACTLY 8 equal square frames, 4 columns x 2 rows, 1024x512. Same origin at exact center of every 256x256 cell, left-to-right chronology. It is a blue/chrome binary energy wall shattering, NOT ice or stone. Frame1 compact rectangular chrome-white overload spark, frame2 angular short blue-white flare, frame3 small rectangular luminous blue binary tile clusters beginning to separate outward from center, frame4 more separated 0/1 tile chips and chrome slivers, frame5 scattered sparse blue binary chips propelled in every direction, frame6 spread sparse small chips, frame7 faint separated glints, frame8 only 3 tiny glints. Peak extents <=105px radius. No background fill or solid cloud, no opaque ball. Individual chips are small clean rectangular digit plates, never enormous jagged rocks. Clear pixel art, restrained electric blue glow, cool steel outlines, white-chrome glints. Progressively expand then fade. Exact grid, generous transparent margins, no labels, no gutters drawn.
prompts.morph: Create a premium 16-bit arcade shooter transformation FX animation spritesheet on transparent background. Exactly TWELVE equal portrait cells, 4 columns by 3 rows, 1024x1152 canvas (each cell 256x384). Chronological left-to-right then next row. Consistent origin and footprint, centered in each cell. Effect concept: a VERTICAL BINARY RECONSTRUCTION SCAN that can overlay a boss to dismantle and rebuild it. NOT a ball, NOT a sphere, NOT a circular portal. Open transparent center so the boss remains readable. Sequence 1-3: slim parallel electric blue/chrome vertical scan rails ignite at left and right with short horizontal 0/1 data streaks; 4-6: rails brighten and thin horizontal silver-blue code scan bands descend from top to middle to bottom; 7-9: rectangular binary fragments align into vertical streams, bright narrow scan band ascends; 10-12: rails split into tiny square sparks, fade away into few glints. Shape remains tall rectangular column, never round. Maximum active region 204x330px centered within each 256x384 cell, transparent safe gutters. White-hot chrome highlights, cobalt blue outlines, luminous binary digit clusters, crisp pixel art not painterly smears. NO boss or character or wall baked in, NO opaque center, NO labels, NO chart borders.
